name: balancer
rootCause: An incident occurred on Balancer today which allowed an attacker to drain funds from 2 pools that contained tokens with transfer fees (sometimes referred to as deflationary tokens). STA and STONK were the tokens in each pool. Note: this only affects pools where a token has these transfer fees. “We were not aware this specific type of attack was possible.” - Incident with non-standard ERC20 deflationary tokens - by Mike McDonald - Balancer Protocol - Medium - Balancer Pool with STA Deflationary Token Incident - by 1inch - Medium - stateraproject.md - Hacker Drains $500K From DeFi Liquidity Provider Balancer - CoinDesk - LOST LIQUIDITY FUND UPDATE - STATERA PROJECT - Medium
